// @bun @bun-cjs
(function(exports, require, module, __filename, __dirname) {"use strict";
var __defProp = Object.defineProperty;
var __getOwnPropNames = Object.getOwnPropertyNames;
var __getOwnPropDesc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor;
var __hasOwnProp = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty;
function __accessProp(key) {
  return this[key];
}
var __toCommonJS = (from) => {
  var entry = (__moduleCache ??= new WeakMap).get(from), desc;
  if (entry)
    return entry;
  entry = __defProp({}, "__esModule", { value: true });
  if (from && typeof from === "object" || typeof from === "function") {
    for (var key of __getOwnPropNames(from))
      if (!__hasOwnProp.call(entry, key))
        __defProp(entry, key, {
          get: __accessProp.bind(from, key),
          enumerable: !(desc = __getOwnPropDesc(from, key)) || desc.enumerable
        });
  }
  __moduleCache.set(from, entry);
  return entry;
};
var __moduleCache;
var __commonJS = (cb, mod) => () => (mod || cb((mod = { exports: {} }).exports, mod), mod.exports);
var __returnValue = (v) => v;
function __exportSetter(name, newValue) {
  this[name] = __returnValue.bind(null, newValue);
}
var __export = (target, all) => {
  for (var name in all)
    __defProp(target, name, {
      get: all[name],
      enumerable: true,
      configurable: true,
      set: __exportSetter.bind(all, name)
    });
};
var __esm = (fn, res, err) => () => {
  if (fn)
    try {
      res = fn(fn = 0);
    } catch (e) {
      err = [e];
    }
  if (err)
    throw err[0];
  return res;
};

// packages/core/src/utils/base64.ts
function base64ToBytes(b64) {
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0;i < bin.length; i++)
    bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes;
}

// packages/core/src/utils/text.ts
function compareCodeUnits(a, b) {
  if (a < b)
    return -1;
  return a > b ? 1 : 0;
}
var XML_ENTITIES, HTML_ENTITIES;
var init_text = __esm(() => {
  XML_ENTITIES = new Map([["amp", "&"], ["lt", "<"], ["gt", ">"], ["quot", '"'], ["apos", "'"]]);
  HTML_ENTITIES = new Map([...XML_ENTITIES, ["nbsp", " "]]);
});

// packages/core/src/http/release-message.ts
var exports_release_message = {};
__export(exports_release_message, {
  RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY: () => RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY,
  RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV: () => RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV,
  verifyRelease: () => verifyRelease
});
function releaseMessage(version, checksums) {
  const lines = Object.entries(checksums).sort(([a], [b]) => compareCodeUnits(a, b)).map(([path, sha256]) => `${path} ${sha256.toLowerCase()}`);
  return new TextEncoder().encode([MESSAGE_PREFIX, version, ...lines, ""].join(`
`));
}
async function verifyRelease(release, publicKeyHex) {
  if (!PUBLIC_KEY_HEX.test(publicKeyHex) || !SIGNATURE_BASE64.test(release.signature))
    return false;
  const publicKey = Uint8Array.from(publicKeyHex.match(/../gu) ?? [], (pair) => Number.parseInt(pair, 16));
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", publicKey, { name: "Ed25519" }, false, ["verify"]);
  return await crypto.subtle.verify("Ed25519", key, base64ToBytes(release.signature), releaseMessage(release.version, release.checksums));
}
var RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY = "232098b9f5cc9b300b903bb9f3347ecb2b62115b2711438ab7fab12d30bfbaef", RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV = "KINU_RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY", MESSAGE_PREFIX = "kinu-release-v1", PUBLIC_KEY_HEX, SIGNATURE_BASE64;
var init_release_message = __esm(() => {
  init_text();
  PUBLIC_KEY_HEX = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/iu;
  SIGNATURE_BASE64 = /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{86}==$/u;
});

// packages/core/src/cli/command-env.ts
var exports_command_env = {};
__export(exports_command_env, {
  DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV: () => DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV,
  fromDotenv: () => fromDotenv,
  launchDotenv: () => launchDotenv,
  launchDotenvFiles: () => launchDotenvFiles,
  unsandboxedCommandEnvironment: () => unsandboxedCommandEnvironment
});
function launchDotenvFiles(nodeEnv) {
  const mode = nodeEnv === undefined || nodeEnv === "" ? "development" : nodeEnv;
  return [".env", `.env.${mode}`, ...mode === "test" ? [] : [".env.local"], `.env.${mode}.local`, ".dev.vars"];
}
function launchDotenv(files) {
  const supplied = new Map;
  for (const file of files) {
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(file))
      if (value !== undefined)
        supplied.set(name, (supplied.get(name) ?? new Set).add(value));
  }
  return supplied;
}
function fromDotenv(dotenv, name, value) {
  return dotenv.get(name)?.has(value) === true;
}
function unsandboxedCommandEnvironment(source, dotenv) {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source).flatMap(([name, value]) => value === undefined || WITHHELD_COMMAND_ENV.has(name) || fromDotenv(dotenv, name, value) ? [] : [[name, value]]));
}
var PROVIDER_KEY_ENV, SESSION_CREDENTIAL_ENV, DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV = "KINU_DAEMON_PREDECESSOR", WITHHELD_COMMAND_ENV;
var init_command_env = __esm(() => {
  init_release_message();
  PROVIDER_KEY_ENV = {
    openaiApiKey: "OPENAI_API_KEY",
    anthropicApiKey: "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
    openrouterApiKey: "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
  };
  SESSION_CREDENTIAL_ENV = { token: "KINU_TOKEN", auth: "KINU_AUTH", gatewayAuth: "AI_GATEWAY_AUTH" };
  WITHHELD_COMMAND_ENV = new Set([
    ...Object.values(PROVIDER_KEY_ENV),
    ...Object.values(SESSION_CREDENTIAL_ENV),
    RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV,
    DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV
  ]);
});

// packages/pc-agent/src/update.js
var fs = require("fs");
var os = require("os");
var path = require("path");
var crypto2 = require("crypto");
var { execFile, spawn } = require("child_process");
function runToExit(file, args, options) {
  const { promise, resolve } = Promise.withResolvers();
  const child = execFile(file, args, options, (error, stdout, stderr) => resolve({ error, stdout, stderr }));
  child.stdin.end();
  return promise;
}
var VERSION_STAMP = "pc-agent.version";
var { RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY: RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY2, RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV: RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV2 } = (init_release_message(), __toCommonJS(exports_release_message));
var UPDATE_PENDING_MARKER = "pc-agent.update-pending";
var { DAEMON_PREDECESSOR_ENV: PREDECESSOR_ENV } = (init_command_env(), __toCommonJS(exports_command_env));
var ARCHIVE_DAEMON_DIR = path.join("kinu", "pc-agent");
var UPDATE_FRAME = "UPDATE";
function readVersionStamp(dir) {
  try {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, VERSION_STAMP), "utf8").trim();
    return text === "" ? null : text;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err && err.code === "ENOENT")
      return null;
    throw new Error(`read the daemon version stamp in ${dir}`, { cause: err });
  }
}
function updateOptedOut(deviceHome) {
  let text;
  try {
    text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(deviceHome, "config.json"), "utf8");
  } catch (err) {
    if (err && err.code === "ENOENT")
      return false;
    throw new Error("read the CLI config beside the device config", { cause: err });
  }
  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (err) {
    if (!(err instanceof SyntaxError))
      throw err;
    return true;
  }
  return Object(parsed) === parsed && parsed.updateCheck === false;
}
function clearPendingMarker(deviceHome) {
  fs.rmSync(path.join(deviceHome, UPDATE_PENDING_MARKER), { force: true });
}
function isUpdateFrame(msg) {
  return Boolean(msg) && msg.type === UPDATE_FRAME;
}
function stringOrNull(value) {
  return Object(value) instanceof String ? String(value) : null;
}
function parseUpdateFrame(msg) {
  const version = (stringOrNull(msg.version) ?? "").trim();
  if (version === "")
    return { error: "no version" };
  const urls = Object(msg.urls) === msg.urls ? msg.urls : {};
  const tarball = stringOrNull(urls.tarball);
  const checksum = stringOrNull(urls.checksum);
  if (tarball === null || checksum === null)
    return { error: "no urls" };
  if (!tarball.startsWith("/") || !checksum.startsWith("/"))
    return { error: "urls must be same-origin paths" };
  const sha256 = stringOrNull(msg.sha256);
  if (sha256 === null || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(sha256))
    return { error: "no sha256" };
  const rawChecksums = Object(msg.checksums) === msg.checksums ? msg.checksums : null;
  const signature = stringOrNull(msg.signature);
  if (rawChecksums === null || signature === null || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/.test(signature))
    return { error: "no signature" };
  const checksums = {};
  for (const [artifact, raw] of Object.entries(rawChecksums)) {
    const digest = stringOrNull(raw);
    if (!artifact.startsWith("/") || digest === null || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(digest))
      return { error: "malformed checksums" };
    checksums[artifact] = digest.toLowerCase();
  }
  if (checksums[tarball] !== sha256.toLowerCase())
    return { error: "the checksum named is not the signed one" };
  return { version, tarball, checksum, sha256: sha256.toLowerCase(), checksums, signature };
}
function pinnedPublicKey() {
  const fromEnv = process.env[RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_ENV2] ?? "";
  return fromEnv === "" ? RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY2 : fromEnv;
}
function releaseSignatureHolds(frame, publicKeyHex = pinnedPublicKey()) {
  return verifyRelease(frame, publicKeyHex);
}
async function fetchBytes(fetchFn, url) {
  const res = await fetchFn(url, { cache: "no-store" });
  if (!res.ok)
    throw new Error(`download ${url}: HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
}
async function downloadVerified(fetchFn, origin, frame) {
  const bytes = await fetchBytes(fetchFn, origin + frame.tarball);
  const published = new TextDecoder().decode(await fetchBytes(fetchFn, origin + frame.checksum)).trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || "";
  if (published.toLowerCase() !== frame.sha256)
    throw new Error("the published checksum is not the one the UPDATE frame named");
  const actual = crypto2.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
  if (actual !== published.toLowerCase())
    throw new Error(`checksum mismatch for ${frame.tarball}`);
  return bytes;
}
function writeAtomically(file, content, mode) {
  const temporary = `${file}.tmp-${process.pid}-${crypto2.randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
  const descriptor = fs.openSync(temporary, "wx", mode);
  try {
    fs.writeFileSync(descriptor, content);
    fs.fsyncSync(descriptor);
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(descriptor);
  }
  fs.renameSync(temporary, file);
}
function syncDirectory(dir) {
  if (os.platform() === "win32")
    return;
  const descriptor = fs.openSync(dir, "r");
  try {
    fs.fsyncSync(descriptor);
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(descriptor);
  }
}
function landFile(target) {
  if (fs.existsSync(target))
    fs.renameSync(target, `${target}.prev`);
  fs.renameSync(`${target}.new`, target);
}
function restoreFile(target) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(`${target}.prev`))
    return;
  fs.renameSync(`${target}.prev`, target);
}
function landDaemonFiles(layout, extracted, version) {
  const source = path.join(extracted, ARCHIVE_DAEMON_DIR);
  const daemon = path.basename(layout.daemonPath);
  if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(source, daemon)))
    throw new Error(`the archive carries no ${daemon} for the daemon`);
  const siblings = fs.readdirSync(source).filter((name) => name !== daemon && name !== VERSION_STAMP).sort();
  const fresh = siblings.filter((name) => !fs.existsSync(path.join(layout.deviceHome, name)));
  const names = [...siblings, daemon];
  const shipped = readVersionStamp(source);
  if (shipped !== version)
    throw new Error(`the archive is stamped ${shipped ?? "nothing"}, not ${version}`);
  for (const name of names) {
    writeAtomically(`${path.join(layout.deviceHome, name)}.new`, fs.readFileSync(path.join(source, name)), 448);
  }
  writeAtomically(`${path.join(layout.deviceHome, VERSION_STAMP)}.new`, `${version}
`, 384);
  for (const name of siblings)
    landFile(path.join(layout.deviceHome, name));
  landFile(layout.daemonPath);
  landFile(path.join(layout.deviceHome, VERSION_STAMP));
  syncDirectory(layout.deviceHome);
  return { siblings, fresh };
}
async function selftest(layout) {
  const { error, stdout, stderr } = await runToExit(layout.runtime, [layout.daemonPath, "--selftest"], {
    cwd: layout.deviceHome,
    env: { ...process.env, KINU_HOME: layout.deviceHome },
    encoding: "utf8",
    timeout: 60000
  });
  if (error !== null && !Number.isInteger(error.code))
    throw new Error("the landed daemon could not be run", { cause: error });
  if (error !== null)
    throw new Error(`the landed daemon failed its selftest (exit ${error.code}): ${String(stderr).trim()}`);
  return String(stdout).trim();
}
function rollBack(layout, landed) {
  restoreFile(layout.daemonPath);
  for (const name of landed.siblings) {
    const file = path.join(layout.deviceHome, name);
    if (landed.fresh.includes(name))
      fs.rmSync(file, { force: true });
    else
      restoreFile(file);
  }
  restoreFile(path.join(layout.deviceHome, VERSION_STAMP));
  syncDirectory(layout.deviceHome);
}
async function extractArchive(bytes, into) {
  const archive = path.join(into, "cli.tar.gz");
  fs.writeFileSync(archive, bytes);
  const { error, stderr } = await runToExit("tar", ["-xzf", archive, "-C", into], { encoding: "utf8" });
  if (error !== null && !Number.isInteger(error.code))
    throw new Error("tar could not run", { cause: error });
  if (error !== null)
    throw new Error(`unpacking the archive failed: ${String(stderr).trim()}`);
}
function describeFailure(err) {
  if (!(err instanceof Error))
    return String(err);
  return err.cause instanceof Error ? `${err.message} (${err.cause.message})` : err.message;
}
function lifelineClosed(stream) {
  const { promise, resolve } = Promise.withResolvers();
  stream.once("end", resolve);
  stream.once("close", resolve);
  stream.once("error", resolve);
  stream.resume();
  return promise;
}
function createUpdater(opts) {
  const {
    layout,
    origin,
    log,
    fetchFn = fetch,
    spawnFn = spawn,
    reclaim
  } = opts;
  let pending = false;
  let inProgress = false;
  let landed = { siblings: [], fresh: [] };
  function startSuccessor(version) {
    writeAtomically(path.join(layout.deviceHome, UPDATE_PENDING_MARKER), `${version}
`, 384);
    const child = spawnFn(layout.runtime, [layout.daemonPath], {
      cwd: layout.deviceHome,
      detached: true,
      stdio: ["pipe", "inherit", "inherit"],
      env: { ...process.env, KINU_HOME: layout.deviceHome, [PREDECESSOR_ENV]: String(process.pid) }
    });
    pending = true;
    child.once("exit", (code) => {
      log(`device.update_successor_exited pid=${child.pid} code=${code}`);
      function reportRollbackFailure(error) {
        log("device.update_rollback_failed", describeFailure(error));
      }
      (async () => {
        rollBack(layout, landed);
        clearPendingMarker(layout.deviceHome);
        await reclaim?.();
        log(`device.update_rolled_back version=${version}`);
      })().catch(reportRollbackFailure).finally(() => {
        pending = false;
      });
    });
    child.unref();
    log(`device.update_successor_started pid=${child.pid} version=${version}`);
  }
  async function apply(frame) {
    if (readVersionStamp(layout.deviceHome) !== frame.version) {
      const work = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(layout.deviceHome, "pc-agent.update-"));
      try {
        await extractArchive(await downloadVerified(fetchFn, origin, frame), work);
        landed = landDaemonFiles(layout, work, frame.version);
      } finally {
        fs.rmSync(work, { recursive: true, force: true });
      }
    }
    let reported;
    try {
      reported = await selftest(layout);
    } catch (err) {
      rollBack(layout, landed);
      throw new Error("the landed daemon failed its selftest; the previous build was restored", { cause: err });
    }
    if (reported !== frame.version) {
      rollBack(layout, landed);
      throw new Error(`the landed daemon reports ${reported}, not ${frame.version}; the previous build was restored`);
    }
    startSuccessor(frame.version);
  }
  return {
    pending: () => pending,
    handle(msg) {
      if (!isUpdateFrame(msg))
        return false;
      if (pending || inProgress) {
        log("device.update_ignored reason=already_pending");
        return true;
      }
      if (updateOptedOut(layout.deviceHome)) {
        log("device.update_ignored reason=updateCheck_false");
        return true;
      }
      const frame = parseUpdateFrame(msg);
      if (frame.error) {
        log(`device.update_ignored reason=malformed_frame detail=${frame.error}`);
        return true;
      }
      function reportUpdateFailure(error) {
        log("device.update_failed", describeFailure(error));
      }
      inProgress = true;
      releaseSignatureHolds(frame).then((holds) => {
        if (!holds) {
          log(`device.update_ignored reason=bad_signature version=${frame.version}`);
          return;
        }
        log(`device.update_started version=${frame.version}`);
        return apply(frame);
      }).catch(reportUpdateFailure).finally(() => {
        inProgress = false;
      });
      return true;
    }
  };
}
var REFUSAL_REASON_MAX = 1000;
async function reportRefusal({ origin, cfg, version, runtime, reason, fetchFn = fetch }) {
  const res = await fetchFn(`${origin}/pc/update-refused`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ user: cfg.user, token: cfg.token, version, runtime, reason: reason.slice(0, REFUSAL_REASON_MAX) })
  });
  return res.status;
}
module.exports = {
  VERSION_STAMP,
  UPDATE_PENDING_MARKER,
  PREDECESSOR_ENV,
  lifelineClosed,
  UPDATE_FRAME,
  readVersionStamp,
  updateOptedOut,
  clearPendingMarker,
  createUpdater,
  runToExit,
  reportRefusal
};
})
